recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交中，許多大小不一的細胞核呈深藍黑色訊號，包括幾顆大型不規則核的大細胞，背景其他細胞為淡紅色對比染色；證實這些大細胞帶有 EBV，支持 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍。
features: Strong dark blue nuclear EBER signal in numerous cells
Positive cells range from small to large, including large irregular and lobated nuclei corresponding to giant cells
Signal is confined to nuclei with clean cytoplasm
Many background cells are negative with pink nuclear fast red counterstain
describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) shows strong nuclear positivity in numerous cells, including the large atypical giant cells as well as a spectrum of smaller and intermediate-sized cells. The remaining background inflammatory cells are negative on the nuclear fast red counterstain. The presence of many EBER-positive cells of varying size, including the HRS-like cells, establishes an EBV-driven B-cell proliferation; in a circumscribed mucocutaneous ulcer in an immunosuppressed host, findings are consistent with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer.

ddx.vs: EBER is largely restricted to HRS cells with few positive small cells, and the HRS cells are CD15+ and CD20-negative in a nodal setting.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBER-positive large cells form confluent sheets producing a mass or systemic disease rather than a spectrum of scattered positive cells in a localized ulcer.
Scattered EBER-positive immunoblasts in tonsil or node in a young immunocompetent patient with positive heterophile serology, without an ulcer confined to mucosa or skin.
